primary_question: Was the lead pin incompletely seated?
narrative_cues: under-insert; incomplete insertion; not fully inserted; terminal pin; reseat; reinsert
structured_problem_codes: Difficult to Insert (1316); Fitting Problem (2183); Misconnection (1399); Connection Problem (2900)
inclusion_rule: Narrative identifies or strongly suspects incomplete seating in header
common_false_positive: Normal-looking differences in terminal-pin depth with normal electrical testing
certainty_rule: CONFIRMED only if visual/lab/procedural evidence supports; SUSPECTED if technical-services differential only

primary_question: Was the lead attached incorrectly in the header?
narrative_cues: incorrectly attached; wrong port; misconnection; detached and re-attached; reconnect
structured_problem_codes: Misconnection (1399); Loose or Intermittent Connection (1371); Connection Problem (2900)
inclusion_rule: Narrative localizes abnormality to header attachment and correction occurs with reconnection
common_false_positive: Generic high impedance without interface localization
certainty_rule: PROBABLE if re-seating normalizes parameters; CONFIRMED requires inspection or returned-product evidence

primary_question: Was there intermittent terminal-to-header electrical contact?
narrative_cues: intermittent connection; header contact; connector block; spring contact; terminal ring
structured_problem_codes: Loose or Intermittent Connection (1371); Connection Problem (2900); Signal Artifact/Noise (1036)
inclusion_rule: Narrative specifically implicates terminal/header contact or reproduced contact intermittency
common_false_positive: Lead conductor fracture near terminal can mimic header intermittency
certainty_rule: Require differential/root-cause field so near-terminal fracture is not counted as header failure

narrative_cues: set screw; setscrew; screw block; torque; loose screw
structured_problem_codes: Loose or Intermittent Connection (1371); Connection Problem (2900)
certainty_rule: CONFIRMED/PROBABLE only with explicit setscrew evidence

primary_question: Did header bore geometry/obstruction prevent normal insertion?
narrative_cues: difficult to insert; bore; connector port; obstruction; pin gauge
structured_problem_codes: Difficult to Insert (1316); Fitting Problem (2183); Connection Problem (2900)
inclusion_rule: Insertion difficulty localizes to generator header/bore
certainty_rule: Use returned-device pin-gauge testing when available

primary_question: Did fluid/contamination cross the sealing system?
narrative_cues: fluid; blood; ingress; moisture; contamination; seal; sealing ring
structured_problem_codes: Electrical Shorting (2926); Connection Problem (2900); corrosion-related codes
inclusion_rule: Narrative or analysis documents fluid/contamination at connector interface
common_false_positive: Pocket fluid with no evidence it crossed connector seals

primary_question: Was there current leakage between isolated connector poles?
narrative_cues: current leakage; leakage path; between contacts; cross-contact; conductive bridge
inclusion_rule: Narrative/manufacturer analysis identifies leakage between connector contacts
common_false_positive: The word crosstalk in sensing narrative alone
certainty_rule: Never infer physical leakage from oversensing alone

primary_question: Was there a physical short between contact regions?
narrative_cues: short circuit; short between; conductive bridge; contact-to-contact
inclusion_rule: Physical/electrical analysis supports a short between connector poles
common_false_positive: Lead-body internal short or can-to-header antenna short
certainty_rule: Must localize short to lead-header contact system

primary_question: Was cross-channel/crosstalk sensing reported without proven physical leakage?
common_false_positive: Physical connector short if separately proven

primary_question: Was the header specifically evaluated and found normal?
narrative_cues: header normal; connector normal; set screws normal; spring elements normal; bore normal; pin gauge normal
inclusion_rule: Manufacturer or procedural testing explicitly clears header/interface
certainty_rule: Useful negative control for adjudication and model validation

primary_question: Did a generator-header component arc/short independently of the lead-pin interface?
narrative_cues: arc-over; antenna; external short; header assembly
inclusion_rule: Root cause localized to generator header component other than lead-contact interface
certainty_rule: Keep separate so header manufacturing failures do not contaminate DF1/DF4 connector analysis
